title: CUB sparse keypoint annotation budget-response replication
direction: annotation value and sample-selection robustness; not MNAR correction

sampling.mechanism: Uniform sampling without replacement within every class and fold-training set.
sampling.paired_design: For every selection seed, one random permutation is generated per class/fold and K1 is nested in K2, which is nested in K4.

training.model: Frozen PAT-D-260728-001 ResNet-50 layer4-adapted PrPool stack

primary_endpoints: mean and range of OOF balanced accuracy over three selection seeds for K1, K2, and K4
fraction of stored Full-Oracle gain retained
negative-transfer class rate and worst-class recall delta

go_no_go.sparse_annotation_value_supported_if: K1 mean retains at least 60% of the stored Full-Oracle gain, every K1 seed is at least 2 pp above stored Global, and official test access remains zero.
go_no_go.selection_robustness_supported_if: The K1 OOF BA range across three independent selection seeds is at most 2 pp.
go_no_go.on_go: Develop an annotation-budget/sample-selection study; next compare random selection with active annotation-value heuristics under the same budget.
go_no_go.on_no_go: Do not claim one-image-per-class efficiency; reassess training-seed sensitivity or stop the CUB sparse-annotation direction.
